name: PolyDoc
desc: Convert HTML or a URL to PDF, capture screenshots, and generate EU e-invoices (Factur-X / ZUGFeRD).

actions.name: convert_to_pdf
actions.description: Convert HTML, a URL, or a saved template to a PDF.

actions.name: capture_screenshot
actions.description: Capture a screenshot of a URL, inline HTML, or a saved template.

actions.name: generate_einvoice
actions.description: Generate a hybrid e-invoice PDF (Factur-X / ZUGFeRD, EN 16931) from a visual layout plus structured invoice data.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
